description.value:
You can tap into and channel the divine energies of the Universe to cast spells. You might be blessed, pious, an esoteric scientist, or—as most other verthanis assume—a chosen God-Vessel representing your divinity. Choose one of the following 1st-rank divine spells: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Bane], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Bless], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Command], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Fear], or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Protection]. You can cast the selected spell as a divine innate spell once per day.

Special If you have the devotional verthani heritage, you can instead select two spells from the listed options, and you can cast each of the selected spells as a divine innate spell once per day.
